name: com.setsuodu.simdjson
description: High-performance SIMD-accelerated JSON parser for Unity, powered by the simdjson C++ library. Provides a complete runtime C# API with native plugin, samples demonstrating all methods, and benchmarks against Newtonsoft.Json (com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json).

samples.description: Demonstrates all runtime API methods and includes a benchmark comparing against AOT-optimized Newtonsoft.Json.
